ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 40:60 distribution of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white field on the left lobe with dense black mottling; solid low-intensity black field occupies the lower center and majority of the right lobe with sparse white speckling on the upper right margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 20 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude forming a jagged profile across the entire visible trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a convex curve ending in a downward-tilted tip; right lobe exhibits a convex outer boundary on an upward-oriented trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive clusters of high-contrast, circular/conical 3D structures (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, dark linear scratches visible on the white surface of the left lobe, including one primary curved abrasion and multiple smaller unaligned marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle infestation on both fluke tips; visible irregular indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe near the central notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific black 'splatter' or mottling pattern on the left lobe's high-intensity region, creating a unique textural gradient.
